The '''Bird House''' is a piece of outdoor [[furniture]] that can be purchased from [[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|5000}}, when [[Marnie]] is tending the shop, or any time if the player has acquired the [[Animal Catalogue]].

It can only be placed outside.

Once placed, there is a chance that a bird will appear daily, even in winter. If [[The Player]] gets too close to the birdhouse, the bird will fly away.

==Secrets==
{{Collapse|content=If a player has [[Children#Dismissing Children|dismissed children]], there is a chance for a dove to appear at the bird house.
